name: ChatPlus Co.,Ltd.
summary: ChatPlus Co., Ltd. develops and provides subscription-based SaaS chatbot systems in Japan. The service helps companies improve efficiency by automating the handling of inquiries from inside and outside the organization. It offers ChatPlus, a chatbot automating corporate inquiries and communication, and AI Agent Plus, along with a tool for organizing frequently asked questions. Incorporated in 2016, it has its base in Chiyoda, Japan.
